psalm-24-1.verse: The earth is the Lord’s, and all it contains, The world, and those who dwell in it.
psalm-24-1.prayer: Lord, the earth and everything in it belong to You. Help me remember that all I have comes from Your hand and should be used for Your glory.

psalm-24-2.verse: For He has founded it upon the seas And established it upon the rivers.
psalm-24-2.prayer: Father, thank You for creating and sustaining all things. Remind me daily of Your power, wisdom, and authority over creation.

psalm-24-3.verse: Who may ascend into the hill of the Lord? And who may stand in His holy place?
psalm-24-3.prayer: Lord, I desire to draw near to You and stand in Your presence. Help me pursue a life that honors You and reflects Your holiness.

psalm-24-4.verse: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, Who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood And has not sworn deceitfully.
psalm-24-4.prayer: Father, give me clean hands and a pure heart. Help me live with integrity, sincerity, and faithfulness in all that I do.

psalm-24-5.verse: He shall receive a blessing from the Lord And righteousness from the God of his salvation.
psalm-24-5.prayer: Lord, thank You for Your blessing and righteousness. Help me walk humbly before You and receive Your grace with gratitude.

psalm-24-6.verse: This is the generation of those who seek Him, Who seek Your face—even Jacob. Selah.
psalm-24-6.prayer: Father, let me be among those who seek Your face. Create within me a deeper desire to know You and follow You wholeheartedly.

psalm-24-7.verse: Lift up your heads, O gates, And be lifted up, O ancient doors, That the King of glory may come in!
psalm-24-7.prayer: Lord, open the doors of my heart and let the King of Glory reign fully in my life. Remove anything that stands in the way of Your rule.

psalm-24-8.verse: Who is the King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, The Lord mighty in battle.
psalm-24-8.prayer: Father, You are strong and mighty. Help me trust in Your power when I face challenges that seem greater than my own strength.

psalm-24-9.verse: Lift up your heads, O gates, And lift them up, O ancient doors, That the King of glory may come in!
psalm-24-9.prayer: Lord, once again I open my heart to You. May every area of my life be surrendered to Your leadership and guidance.

psalm-24-10.verse: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, He is the King of glory. Selah.
psalm-24-10.prayer: Father, You are the King of Glory. May my life bring honor, praise, and worship to Your holy name forever.

psalm-24-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for being the Creator of all things and the King of Glory. Help me live with clean hands and a pure heart, seeking Your presence above all else. Reign over every area of my life and teach me to trust in Your power, walk in Your righteousness, and worship You with my whole heart. May my life continually bring glory and honor to You.

In Jesus’ name, Amen. 🙏🏻
